en-US.title: Fe3dr: Homemade Food
en-US.subtitle: Tiffin & meals from home cooks
en-US.description:
Real home cooking, from a kitchen near you.

Fe3dr connects you with FSSAI-licensed home chefs cooking the food they actually cook for their own families — dal chawal, biryani, thalis, regional dishes you will not find on a restaurant menu. Order a single meal or set up a weekly tiffin.

WHY FE3DR
• Home chefs, not cloud kitchens — every chef is a licensed individual with a name and a story
• Cooked to order, not held under a heat lamp
• Daily menus that change, because home cooks cook what is fresh
• Delivery or pickup, whichever suits you

ORDER YOUR WAY
• Browse chefs near you and see today's menu
• À la carte for a one-off meal
• Weekly tiffin plans for lunch or dinner, with veg and non-veg options per day
• Group orders — share a link, everyone adds their dishes, one checkout
• Skip days, pause, or cancel your plan whenever you need to

KNOW WHERE YOUR FOOD IS
• Live order status from accepted to on the way
• Map tracking once your order is out for delivery
• Your exact address stays private — chefs see your area, not your door

EAT WITH CONFIDENCE
• Every chef is FSSAI licensed and verified before they can sell
• Dietary tags and declared allergens on every dish
• Ratings and reviews from people who actually ordered
• Report or block anyone, any time

PAY SIMPLY
• UPI, cards, netbanking and wallets via Razorpay
• Wallet credit and refunds handled in-app
• No subscription fee to browse or order

Fe3dr is available in India. Prices are set by the chefs themselves — you are paying a cook, not a chain.

Questions? support@fe3dr.com

review.notes:
Fe3dr is a marketplace for home-cooked food in India. Food is prepared by independent, FSSAI-licensed home chefs and delivered by third-party partners.

IMPORTANT FOR REVIEW — SEEING CHEFS: chefs are shown by delivery reach, so a device located outside India will see an empty list. To see the marketplace populated, sign in with the demo account below: it has a saved Indian delivery address already set as default, and the chef list resolves against that address rather than device location. Do not grant location permission; the app does not need it to show chefs.

You do not need an account to browse. Tap 'Browse without an account' on the sign-in screen to see chefs and menus. An account is required only to place an order, save a chef, or view order history.

PAYMENTS are handled by Razorpay. All purchases are physical goods — real meals delivered to a physical address — so In-App Purchase does not apply (guideline 3.1.1). There is no digital content in the app.

REPORTING AND BLOCKING: tap the ... menu on any chef post or review to report it or block its author. Blocked accounts are managed at Profile > Blocked accounts.

ACCOUNT DELETION: Profile > Pause or delete account. Confirm by typing the account email. Also available at https://fe3dr.com/account-deletion.

The app is offered in India only.
